evidence: Atomic layer deposition of cobalt silicide (CoSi2) thin films on H-terminated Si(111) surfaces, using the cobalt-based precursor tertiarybutylallylcobalttricarbonyl (tBu-AllylCo-(CO)3) and trisilane, is investigated by in situ Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) and ex situ X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to uncover the film growth mechanisms.
